title: Jessa Blu
meta_description: Jessa Blu is a stylish 4BR home in a gated 30A community with pool views, two balconies, a grill, and access to a gym, trails and Blue Mountain Beach.
description_expanded:
"May all your blues be the ocean and the sky"

ABOUT HOME: Jessa Blu is a beautifully designed home in the gated community of the Village of Blue Mountain Beach just off 30A. This home has everything you need for a memorable beach vacation. This lovely 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath home has the feel of relaxed luxury throughout and comfortably sleeps 10. The home features an outdoor shower, two balconies (one overlooking the pool), and an outdoor grill. The olympic size pool is steps from the back door along with workout facility, covered gazebo, corn hole, and shuffle board. Get ready for some family fun!

ABOUT AREA: This lovely coastal home is located in Blue Mountain Beach, which has been awarded a national "Blue Wave" designation for the pristine cleanliness of the sugar sand shoreline. This coastal community rests between Santa Rosa Beach and Grayton Beach State Park and is known for its tranquility, many restaurants, and family atmosphere. The natural beauty of the sugar sand beaches, walking, biking trails and adventure await you. Spend your mornings grabbing coffee and pastries from Blue Mountain Bakery and evenings strolling to dinner at Blue Mabel Restaurant. Don't forget to grab dessert, or better yet, don't wait for dessert! Stop by Blue Mountain Beach Creamery after your bike ride or day at the beach to find out why so many argue it's the best ice cream in town.

BEACH ACCESS: The closest beach is Blue Mountain Regional Beach Access, just a few blocks away, at the end of Hwy 83. There are restrooms, showers, and parking. Coolers, wagons and single inflatable toys are permitted, as well as kayaks and paddle boards.

ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps 10
• Bedroom 1 -- King, Ensuite (1st Floor)
• Bedroom 2 -- King, Ensuite (2nd Floor)
• Bedroom 3 -- Queen, Ensuite (2nd Floor)
• Bedroom 4 -- Bunk Room, Queen/Queen plus Twin (2nd Floor)

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Gated Community
• Olympic size community pool (Heated in winter)
• Two Balconies with outdoor seating
• Pool View
• 2 Bicycles
• Master on Main
• Grill
• Washer \& Dryer
• WIFI
• Self-Check-In
• Coffee Makers
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath towels, wash clothes
• Fully stocked kitchen

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach
